approve.title: Approve
approve.label: Comment

approve_conditions.title: Approve with conditions
approve_conditions.label: Conditions

request_changes.title: Request changes
request_changes.label: What must change
request_changes.placeholder: For example: Add disclosure D-7 v3 after the payment amount.
request_changes.help: The owner gets this message and uploads a new version.

reject.title: Reject this version
reject.label: Reason
reject.placeholder: For example: The offer does not exist for this product.
reject.help: This version must not run. The owner can still submit a new version.

escalate.title: Escalate
escalate.description: Add a required group. The material stays In review until that group approves too.
escalate.label: Reason
escalate.placeholder: For example: The ad mentions home equity, so Mortgage must review it.
escalate.help: The new group sees this reason in their queue.

retract.title: Retract your approval
retract.label: Reason
retract.placeholder: For example: The rate sheet changed after I approved.
retract.help: Your groups count as waiting again. You can retract only your own approval.

override.label_other: {{count}} High findings are open. Approving needs an override reason.
override.placeholder: For example: The APR disclosure is in the image, which the code check does not read.
override.help: The audit log records this reason with your name.

history.note: The audit log is append-only. Nobody can edit or delete entries.

check.heading: How ClearPath checks it
check.triggerTerms: Code check. When the content contains any of these terms, it must also contain this disclosure:
check.requiredDisclosure: Code check. Every material it applies to must contain this disclosure:
check.phraseRequired: Code check. The content must contain at least one of these:
check.phraseBanned: Code check. The content must not contain any of these phrases:
check.rateSheet: Code check. Each rate and fee in the content is compared with the current range for its product in the
check.hiddenText: Code check. Looks for hidden text, zero-width characters, and text in the same color as its background.
check.ai: AI check. The AI reviewer reads the content with this guidance. Its findings are suggestions; a reviewer decides.

dependents.note: When this rule changes, these materials are flagged for re-review.

metrics.loadError: The metrics did not load. Refresh the page to try again.
metrics.empty: Nothing to show for these filters.
metrics.queueNote_one: {{count}} open item. The oldest has waited {{oldest}} business days.
metrics.queueNote_other: {{count}} open items. The oldest has waited {{oldest}} business days.
metrics.queueAge: Columns show business days waiting. The review target is 2 business days.
metrics.byGroupNote: Business days. A decision counts for every group that had to approve it. "No material change" is a new version that takes the short path.
metrics.topIssuesNote: Findings that reviewers kept, by rule.
metrics.noGroupFilter: The reviewer group filter does not apply to live content.
metrics.postApprovalDef: Approved materials where monitoring later found a violation that was already there at approval. It measures the whole review, people and AI.
metrics.aiFixDef: AI findings that became Outdated because the next version changed the flagged text. A rough signal of AI precision.
metrics.aiMissDef: Reviewer comments on selected text that no AI finding covered. A rough signal of AI recall.
metrics.evalNote: AI precision and recall on the evaluation set are in the test report, not here.
